readiness.primary_reason: Case includes explicit states, target/decoy entities, node regions, hotspot spans, typed objectives, and confidence/clash guardrails; wet-lab construct details can further tighten thresholds.

design_goal.primary: Design a VH-linker-VL scFv that binds a known CD25 epitope while rejecting an IL2RB/CD122 decoy surface.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: Improve the typed positive-state objectives while suppressing typed negative/decoy objectives, preserving local node confidence, and avoiding severe clashes or unfolding.

positive_signals: A majority of CD25 contacts stay on the specified epitope spans.
CDR node confidence remains above the hard floor.
failure_signals: Decoy IL2RB interface is comparable to CD25.
Contacts are mostly outside the specified CD25 epitope.
Interface relies on linker/framework rather than CDRs.
CDRs collapse or severe clashes dominate.

information_gaps: Whether basiliximab-like competition is required or just CD25-selective binding.
Preferred developability liabilities and CDR length bounds.
